facts.claim: The cross-industry app retention average is 25% at day 1, 8% at day 7 and 4% at day 30
facts.source_title: Mobile App Retention Benchmarks by Industry
facts.excerpt: The industry average in 2026 is 25% on Day-1, 8% on Day-7, and 4% at Day-30.

facts.claim: E-commerce apps retain a median 18% at day 1, 5% at day 7 and 2% at day 30, with strong performers at 25-30%, 8-12% and 3-6%
facts.source_title: App Retention Benchmarks: How Your App Stacks Up by Industry
facts.excerpt: Ecommerce apps: strong performers 25-30% Day-1, 8-12% Day-7, 3-6% Day-30; medians 18%, 5% and 2%.

facts.claim: Most apps convert 1% to 2% of installs into a purchase, with retail at 1.38% and travel at 2.41%
facts.excerpt: Most mobile apps see install-to-purchase conversion between 1% and 2%. Retail apps 1.38%; travel apps 2.41%.

facts.claim: A good conversion rate for an e-commerce mobile app sits around 2% to 6% depending on order value and purchase frequency
facts.excerpt: A good conversion rate for an ecommerce mobile app sits around 2% to 6%, depending on industry, average order value, product type and purchase frequency.

facts.claim: Only 5% to 7% of apps still retain users at day 30
facts.excerpt: Only 5-7% of apps retain users by day 30, with most apps losing nearly all users within a month.

facts.claim: E-commerce and retail apps retain 3% to 6% by day 30, above the 2% median other sources report for the same category
facts.source_title: Retention rates for mobile apps by industry
facts.excerpt: By Day 30, e-commerce or retail apps retain 3-6%.
